$comment: One file per state or territory under holidays/, named by its ISO 3166-2 code (holidays/AU-QLD.yaml). Lists every whole-day public holiday the state's holidays Act declares for the WHOLE state, by date, for each year in `years`, including the additional weekday the Act gives when a holiday falls on a weekend. A file may also list, flagged, days that are a holiday in only some areas (`localities_vary`), only part of the day (`part_day`) or only for banks (`bank_holiday`), when its sources set those days out completely; whatever else of that kind exists is named in `not_included`. The flags matter because the laws that count business days treat these days differently: some exclude a day only if it is a holiday throughout the state, some in the place where the act is done, some exclude bank holidays too, and Tasmania's security of payment Act treats every listed local and part-day holiday as a whole-day holiday everywhere. Dates, not rules: some holidays are set each year by proclamation or by an event (Victoria's AFL Grand Final Friday, Western Australia's King's Birthday), so no rule reproduces them. A consumer asked about a year outside `years` has no answer and must say so, not assume a weekday.
title: holiday calendar v1

jurisdiction.description: the state or territory, as an ISO 3166-2 code in vocab/jurisdictions.json; must match the file name

holidays_act.description: the Act that declares these holidays

weekend_rule.description: what the Act gives when a holiday falls on a Saturday or Sunday, in the words of the source it was read from. Absent where the source did not state it; the dates in `holidays` still carry the effect.

years.description: the calendar years this file lists completely. Every holiday dated in one of these years is listed; a year not here is unknown.

read.description: the date the source was read

between.description: for a holiday whose date is not yet fixed: the inclusive range it must fall in. A consumer cannot treat any day in the range as an ordinary day.

localities_vary.description: true when this day is a holiday in some areas of the state and not in others: an area-only holiday, or a statewide one that some areas move to another date

part_day.description: true when the holiday covers only part of the day (for example from 11 am)

bank_holiday.description: true when the day is a bank holiday under the holidays Act but not a public holiday

not_included.description: holidays the source lists that this file deliberately leaves out, and why
